title: Verify a part can be requested with only description, quantity and sell price (part number, cost, vendor empty)
permissions_required: WO Lines: Create & Edit + See Financial Data (the sell price is mandatory and has no catalog source).
preconditions: 1. Signed in as Admin at https://sv7301.qa.shopview.com.
2. An open work order with a line is on its Lines tab.
steps: 1. Add a part to a line.
2. Enter only a description, a quantity and a sell price.
3. Leave part number, cost and vendor empty.
4. Save the part.
expected: 1. The part saves successfully.
2. The part appears on the line with its description, quantity and sell price.
3. It is treated as a vendorless part downstream.
4. Adding a vendorless / no-part-number part requires WO Lines: Create & Edit and See Financial Data, because the sell price is mandatory and has no catalog source.
notes: SV-8183 Decision 4 adds a financial gate: vendorless / no-PN add requires See Financial Data (mandatory sell). Not driven live (part-add flow not exercised).

title: Verify adding a part is blocked when description, quantity or sell price is missing
permissions_required: WO Lines: Create & Edit + See Financial Data. A role lacking See Financial Data (e.g. Technician) is used for the permission negative.
preconditions: 2. The add-part dialog is open on a work order line.
steps: 1. Leave the description empty and try to save.
2. Fill description, leave quantity empty and try to save.
3. Fill quantity, leave sell price empty and try to save.
4. As a role without See Financial Data (e.g. Technician), attempt to add a vendorless / no-part-number part.
expected: 1. Saving is blocked when the description is empty.
2. Saving is blocked when the quantity is empty.
3. Saving is blocked when the sell price is empty.
4. A user without See Financial Data (for example a Technician) cannot add a vendorless / no-part-number part, because they cannot enter the mandatory sell price.
design_ref: requirements S5 AC / §9 (See Financial Data gate)
notes: SV-8183 Decision 4: vendorless / no-PN add requires See Financial Data. Field validation and the permission negative not yet verified live. | VIU 2026-07-07 (Tech-unblock pass): Field-required validations and the See-Financial-Data add-part block not driven (part-add sub-form not reached within budget). Tech confirmed lacking seeFinancialData.

title: Verify a vendorless part's type uses the existing source field (vendor or found) and never inventory
preconditions: 2. A vendorless part has been added to a work order line.
steps: 1. Open the vendorless part's detail.
2. Read its source / type field.
expected: 1. The source is 'vendor' or 'found'.
2. It is never set to 'inventory'.
3. It is treated as vendorless downstream.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify a vendorless part is editable after creation
preconditions: 2. A vendorless part exists on a work order line.
steps: 1. Open the vendorless part.
2. Change its description or quantity and save.
expected: 1. The part can be edited after creation.
2. The changes persist.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify a no-part-number part creates no inventory item and no Part History
permissions_required: Work Order edit access + Inventory visibility.
preconditions: 2. A part with description + qty + sell but no part number exists on a work order.
steps: 1. Search inventory for a new item matching the description.
2. Check for any Part History entry for it.
expected: 1. No inventory item is created for the no-PN part.
2. No Part History is written until a part number is added.
notes: Data-integrity check; not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify adding a part number and vendor later transitions the part out of vendorless
preconditions: 2. A vendorless part (no PN, no vendor) exists on a work order.
steps: 1. Edit the part and add a part number.
2. Assign a vendor to it.
3. Observe the part's vendorless status.
expected: 1. Once both a part number and a vendor are present, the part is no longer treated as vendorless.
2. It becomes eligible for downstream inventory / QuickBooks handling.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify a vendorless / no-PN part cannot be received until a part number (and vendor) is entered
permissions_required: Work Order edit access + receive access.
preconditions: 2. A vendorless / no-PN part is on a work order PO.
steps: 1. Open a receive surface (Accept Delivery / Bulk Receive) for that PO.
2. Attempt to receive the part without a part number.
3. Attempt to receive it without a vendor.
expected: 1. Receiving is blocked while the part number is missing.
2. Receiving is blocked while the vendor is missing.
3. Receiving is enabled only after both a part number and a vendor are provided.
notes: Not driven in VIU. Needs live verification.

title: Verify a vendorless vendor-part goes onto the work order's normal PO with no separate dummy PO
preconditions: 2. A work order has a vendor part with no vendor assigned and Create POs is on.
3. The work order has been completed so POs are generated.
steps: 1. Open the PO list at /parts/orders.
2. Find the PO for this work order.
3. Confirm the vendorless part is on that PO.
expected: 1. The vendorless part is placed on the work order's normal PO.
2. No separate 'dummy PO' is created for it.
notes: PO list route /parts/orders confirmed; the no-dummy-PO placement was not driven end to end. Needs live verification.

notes: NOT BUILT. Needs dev complete.

3. Hover the locked sell field.
expected: 1. EXPECTED PER SPEC: quantity and cost are editable; sell is editable while the WO is not invoiced/paid.

title: Verify a no-number part shows 'Missing part number' with Edit → enter → save that persists immediately

title: Verify entering an EXISTING part number links to that item and updates stock/cost/history without overwriting description or category

title: Verify a part cannot be received without a part number (and a vendor for vendor-missing) even on an invoiced/paid WO
